metadata.scenario: A potential client asks about the types of yoga classes available at the studio. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Mary O'Connor. I'm calling to ask about the types of services you offer. Hi, Mary! It's great to hear from you. We offer a range of services including skilled nursing, physical therapy, and personal care assistance. Oh, I see. I was actually looking for information on your personal care assistance. Absolutely! Our personal care assistance is available at a rate of $28 to $35 per hour. Can you tell me what that includes? Certainly! This service includes help with bathing, dressing, grooming, and other personal hygiene needs. That sounds good. I'm also interested in any additional support you provide for anxiety. We have caregivers who are trained to provide compassionate care and support, especially for clients who experience anxiety. That’s reassuring to hear. My anxiety has been pretty high lately, especially with the IV therapy. I understand, Mary. It’s important to have caregivers you can trust. Would you like to discuss scheduling a caregiver? Yes, that would be helpful. I think I might need someone a few times a week. Great! I can match you with a caregiver who specializes in personal care and anxiety management. That would be wonderful! Can you also send me information about the pricing? Of course! I can email you our service pricing breakdown and a care plan outline. Thank you! I appreciate that. Would you like to set up a follow-up call to discuss the care plan after you receive the email? Yes, that sounds good. When would be a good time for you? How about Wednesday at 10 AM? That works for me. Perfect! I’ll send you the email with our pricing details and confirm our call for Wednesday at 10 AM. Thank you so much, Margaret. You've been really helpful. You’re very welcome, Mary! We're here to support you. I appreciate that. Talk to you Wednesday! Talk to you then! Have a great day!
